title: Shared STATE_ACTIVITY_RETRY and schedule_to_close for Replay Vision state-write activities
answers: What retry policy should Replay Vision Postgres state-write activities use?
Thumbnail workflow retry policy for prepare/finalize activities
body:
Short Postgres writes that move an observation or its media between states use `STATE_ACTIVITY_RETRY` (5 attempts, 1s initial, 10s max interval, ~15s backoff) plus `schedule_to_close_timeout=STATE_ACTIVITY_SCHEDULE_TO_CLOSE` (3 min), both in products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/constants.py.
Used in workflow.py (ApplyScanner workflow) and media_workflow.py (prepare/finalize thumbnail). Don't define per-workflow copies like the old `_STATE_ACTIVITY_RETRY` / `_STATE_RETRY`.
The 3-min schedule_to_close is a ceiling that keeps the failure path inside APPLY_SCANNER_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT; maximum_attempts is what actually ends retries.
evaluation_workflow.py still has its own policy (deliberately left out of scope).
